tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products from the Tecno Gz catalog (sourced live from Alegra). Optionally filter by a search term (matches name/reference/brand) and limit the number of results.

search.description: Optional search term matched against product name, reference or brand.

limit.description: Max number of products to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_my_orders
tools.title: Get my shop orders
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's shop orders (Tecno Gz store). Scoped by RLS to the current user.

limit.description: Max number of orders to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_my_repair_orders
tools.title: Get my repair orders
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's service/repair orders at Tecno Gz. Scoped to the current user.
